description:
Get the daily Google Discover trend for a property: two series ("clicks" and "impressions"), each a list of {date, value} points (missing days back-filled with 0), ready for a time-series chart. Discover is the Google Discover feed surface, distinct from Search performance (use get_gsc_summary/get_top_pages for Search). Accepts a date range as presets (last_7_days, last_28_days, last_3_months, last_year) or absolute dates (from/to in Y-m-d). Also returns "points" (number of days) and "insufficient_history" (true when too few points to chart meaningfully). Pass the property ID (UUID) or URL (sc-domain:...) from list_properties.

Cost: 3 credits per call.

Examples:
```json
// Daily Discover clicks/impressions trend over the last 3 months.
{"property":"sc-domain:example.com","range":"last_3_months"}
```

range.description: Date-range preset. Mutually exclusive with from/to; pass either range or both from and to.
